notes.title: Happy ONE YEAR anniversary
notes.content:
Hello holographic friends and starlight dreamers! We’re so happy to talk with all of you again. 

Prepare your best intergalactic outfits, as we are celebrating! Today is the ONE YEAR anniversary since A Long Journey to An Uncertain End launched on PC!  🎉 Time really does fly!  We’re celebrating joining the Steam Summer Sale, where you can jump into this out-of-this-world adventure with 50% off!

It’s definitely been a long journey: from a successful Kickstarter, to PC launch, to Nintendo Switch launch. We’ve been able to go down this path thanks to our friends and found family. All of you, travelers from the stars, have allowed us to fly so far. We’re grateful to have such a lovely community, thanks for your love and support. And if you’re still looking for ways to support, drop a short Steam review letting people know what you think!

Of course, this is not the last adventure for the Crispy Creative team. We’ve been venturing into a more… haunted journey. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/03faa813884c5a3ebc90a14dd9f6dab17cb4274e.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more news in the future, as this is not the last you will be hearing from us!

notes.title: Get to know about Aylah!
notes.content:
Hello intergalactic travelers!
This year we are part of the Visual Novel Festival! A Long Journey to an Uncertain End is a narrative-heavy game, with an eclectic cast of characters that accompany the player in their adventures through the vast space.  While it’s not exactly a visual novel, players that enjoy visual novels will enjoy our space opera game!

What drove us to create a narrative game were the inclusive themes we could explore in a game like this. The diverse crew joining the player in their journey is a great example. All our characters were inspired by people our development team has met in real life. A Long Journey to an Uncertain End is an homage to the diverse people that have influenced our lives: Today, let’s dive into one of the game’s main characters: Aylah Tress. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/d48c087e5795a220233988a0140c9bbda8dbb1af.png[/img]

Aylah was heavily influenced by two people that Creative Director Kylan Coats knew: the first, a friend, former hairstylist, and flamboyant storyteller, and the second, an intimidatingly brilliant former boss. “My former hairstylist, a gay Jewish man from Brooklyn who was in his early 20’s in New York City during the AIDS epidemic, always had some wisdom to share; some response to everything,” says Kylan.

The second person, Kylan’s former boss, was “one of the few mentors I’ve had who really catapulted my personal and professional growth. I’d watch her navigate outright hostile work situations with a degree of empathy and shrewdness I haven’t seen since. Within all of this piercing intellect, there also seemed to be a bit of hippy, flower-power energy from somewhere long ago. This was an ardent, hopeful energy that had stood the test of time somehow.”

Aylah Tress is the first human crewmember to join the player in this Long Journey. Maternal but tough, strong but caring, Aylah is a hopeful advocate for a better world. 

If you have not played the game yet, A Long Journey to an Uncertain End is on sale right now! You can meet Aylah and the rest of the wonderful cast that will join you as you travel through the galaxies!

notes.title: First Light: Patch Notes 07/07/2023

Hello Cosmic Voyagers,

Firstly, a heartfelt salute from the bridge to all our brave captains who have embraced A Long Journey to an Uncertain End. Your support has given us the fuel to keep this ship rocketing through the cosmic narrative we've all come to cherish.

notes.title: MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION
notes.content:
[h2]Content Warning[/h2]
A Long Journey to An Uncertain End centers around your character escaping an abusive relationship with a past partner. Your ex (for whom you can choose a name and pronouns in-game) is pursuing you across the galaxy. If they catch up with you, the game ends. 

While no specifics are discussed about your past relationship with this person, it is clear that they were controlling and possibly even violent. In the game, they are actively stalking the protagonist with malicious intent, and will attempt to hack into their systems in a form of mind control or manipulation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/e6d3086051e6ab71ab8bcee4ec51ae0276c5f2a5.png[/img]

Hello starlight dreamers and extraterrestrial explorers! We have an exciting announcement to make! A new crew member has joined our Long Journey! We are pleased to introduce to you our truth seeker: Kamaria (she/they).

Kamaria Jelani is a descendant of the original Terraformer Dynasties, a slightly mythical history of being born of and coming from the stars. Despite her lofty origins and the expectations that come with them - specifically to lead - Kamaria is instead focused on and inspired by writing. Unfortunately, her passion is not only unappreciated but actively ridiculed by her parents. Her inherent charm and inquisitive nature lend themselves well to pursuits of journalism Will Kamaria find the truth she is seeking for?

notes.title: A new crew member joins the team: B.R.D., the forgotten outcast!
notes.content:
Hello starlight dreamers and extraterrestrial explorers! We have an exciting announcement to make! A new crew member has joined our Long Journey! We are pleased to introduce to you our forgotten outcast: B.R.D (they/them)!

B.R.D.-087- or as they would like to be known, “Bird”- was a Beta Reconnaissance Drone who crafted a robot body for themselves out of their former ship self. Swathed in clothes that make them relatively unidentifiable but for their massive size, B.R.D. could be taken for a human at a distance, but up close there’s no mistaking their mechanical appearance.  As a fellow sentient A.I., will you be able to bond with B.R.D? Or maybe, you’ll find their fiercely self-sufficient personality and bluntness difficult to deal with. Either way, there’s much to learn about B.R.D. Hopefully, you’ll let them join your cosmic adventure.

notes.title: Kickstarter Backer Surveys Sent!
notes.content:
Thank you for letting us take a (much needed) break. Now that we've gotten our space legs back we have updates!

[h1]Backer Surveys[/h1]
The first and most immediate is our partnership with [url=https://a-long-journey-to-an-uncertain-end.backerkit.com/]BackerKit[/url] for our reward fulfillment! All of our backers should have survey links in their emails (be sure to check spam folders!). We're using BackerKit to handle all our backer surveys for things like shipping information and reward questions.

You don't need to create a BackerKit account to fill out your survey. Just click on the survey link in your email, fill it out, and you're good to go! You'll also be able to up your pledge if you'd like (or include an add-on or two)!

We also have good news for those asking about being a [b]late backer[/b]. For a limited time we've provided most of our pledge tiers in our [url=https://a-long-journey-to-an-uncertain-end.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders]BackerKit store[/url]! The same limits from the campaign still apply so if you have your eye on [b]naming an NPC[/b] or [b]becoming a character[/b], grab it while it's still available!

[h1]Stretch Goal[/h1]
Finally, we had a lot of interest in our last stretch goal of a Nintendo Switch version. After talking with the team we decided to keep the stretch goal open! So for those thinking of snagging an add-on or upping their pledge, it will still go towards our Nintendo Switch goal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/9b5b6fa927e27c634ef29e8e1395ec8a03cd8a0d.png[/img]

[h1]Development Update[/h1]
On the development side we've been busy collecting all the feedback from our backers, Discord channels, and livestreams. We also got a few very thorough and helpfully constructive evaluations from you all. Very much appreciated! notes.title: Skills in A Long Journey to an Uncertain End
notes.content:
Hey there! This is Kylan, the creative director at Crispy Creative. We’ve been very busy working on the game and can’t wait to share more progress with you. To start our very first Steam update, we wanted to go through some of the core system designs for Long Journey.

[h2]Know Your Strengths[/h2]

Everyone is good at something, and your crew is no different. Each crew member has a skill they excel at. Currently, there are five main skills:

[b]Deception, Seduction, Muscle, Business, and Tech.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/5d37fa62d20c5042b14f65c29afb6f832ffd7c31.png[/img]

Each skill is related to the other. So, someone who is great at Seduction is OK at Deception and Muscle, but terrible at Business and Tech.

[h2]Jobs[/h2]

Most jobs you encounter will have a recommended skill. Gravotrometer needs repairing? Someone with the Tech skill would be best. Bodyguard needed? Some Muscle would probably be best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38972911/2d0601bcec31eaf88c2043d2e2a0563c4cf084e3.jpg[/img]

Aligning your crew’s skills with the job at hand is only the first step though. Successfully completing jobs may not be so obvious. Some job choices may require skills different than the obvious ones.

Aligning your crew’s skills with the job at hand is only the first step, though. Successfully completing jobs may not be so obvious. Some job choices may require skills different than the obvious ones. That bodyguard job needing Muscle before? When the client asks your crew to pose as their date, some Seduction or Deception skill would undoubtedly help. Get to know your crew, and they might surprise you. Hidden choices will be more obvious, the more your crew reveal themselves. Who knew Truly had a secret fascination with digital pets? Or that Zeke is also into holistic medicine? Or that Aylah is a closet fan of…wait, what? Oh she’d rather I not…ah, fine. You’ll have to ask her yourself! 😉

notes.title: Pull heists as a sentient spaceship in A Long Journey To An Uncertain End
notes.content:
Don’tcha know it’s illegal for spaceships to have consciousness ’round here? Set to take off sometime next year, A Long Journey To An Uncertain End is the galaxy-hopping debut from Crispy Creative, a narrative management space opera that seems to imagine a version of Cowboy Bebop where the eponymous starship had the final say in all the semi-legal shenanigans. And also one where Ein’s a hologram, I guess.
